chunks: Who believe in their Lord's revelations,
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of believing in the Lord's revelations in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, who are considered the perfect exemplars of those who hold firm to divine signs. It underscores the necessity of combining intellectual conviction with practical adherence to revelation, a core tenet of Usuli scholarship. This characteristic serves as a distinguishing mark of true believers who maintain consistency between their inner faith and outer actions.
